newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND TO DECIDE ABOUT FUTURE IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-ALPHAND TO DECIDE ABOUT FUTURE IN JUNE.

text.p: Overall World Cup champion Luc Alphand will decide about his future in Alpine skiing in June, the Austrian news agency APA said on Wednesday.

The 31-year-old Frenchman said during a visit to his ski company in Altenmarkt: "I feel too young to retire and would really like to participate in (the 1998 Winter Olympics in) Nagano. But I have to take my family into consideration."
APA said leading officials at Alphand's ski manufacturers, Atomic, were convinced that Alphand would continue racing for at least another season.
